# PR #170 round 3 correctness verdict

**BLOCK** at `a0967ab023606364e6e2ec5a41db5f6304315f16`.

**F001, F002 and F003 are closed for the declared macOS-only scope.** Approved fake-IO witnesses pass the repaired cases and kill the dirty/cwd/seat mutants. New **F004** concerns an unreadable git-status warning ignored by the remaining dirty brake.

## Closures

- **F001:** prState accepts only terminal MERGED/CLOSED, or OPEN with a full 40-hex head; decide rechecks usable OPEN input. Missing/short heads, empty objects and unknown states spare the candidate instead of becoming head-change evidence.
- **F002:** malformed seat rows reject the usage inventory before any removal; no missing/numeric/empty folder is silently discarded.
- **F003 / S170-001:** macOS lsof must succeed with empty stderr and complete parsable records. Nonzero/partial/error/empty/unparsed output refuses. The Linux /proc implementation and imports are removed.
- Both CLI main and prune reject non-darwin platforms before tool resolution/runner calls. The injected linux/win32/freebsd witness records zero calls. Ordinary freeze remains separate and dependency-free.

## F004, P2: status stderr can report unreadability but still authorize removal

The local-status brake (`pr-freeze.ts:709-716`) considers only exit code and stdout. It ignores stderr.

Given exit 0, empty porcelain stdout and `warning: could not open directory 'untracked/': Permission denied` on stderr, the current code labels the candidate clean. With a merged PR and no other observed usage, it authorizes git worktree remove.

I confirmed that exact input against this head through the approved fake runner over an existing session-only directory. One fake removal call was recorded; no real git command or physical deletion occurred.

The unreadable-directory warning is not positive evidence of a clean worktree. Honor the dirty/unreadable-status brake by sparing the candidate on status stderr/read warnings; conservatively sparing on any nonempty stderr is consistent with these spare-only brakes. Do not rely on a later git remove refusal to substitute for the explicit guard.

Add the exit-0/empty-stdout/unreadable-stderr case and verify that no removal call is made.

## Mutation and execution proof

The final-head Node built-in-only witness used real session-only directories, fake worktree metadata and a recording runner. It made no real git/gh/pij/lsof calls, process scan, live prune or physical removal:

- a readable unused merged candidate selects a fake removal, so negative results are not an always-spare oracle;
- dry-run makes no removal call;
- deleting dirty/status and busy guards is caught by untracked, unreadable-status, nested/symlinked cwd and live-seat-folder cases;
- malformed PR/seat and partial/error cwd cases now spare/refuse with no fake removals;
- unsupported platforms refuse with zero runner calls;
- absolute-path resolution and pre-removal timeout cases pass.

These witnesses do not include the new F004 warning case as a safety pass; its separate log explicitly records the confirmed gap.

Exact-head CI **42432231265** passed. Node 22 executed all **32 pr-freeze tests**, with 2256 tests passed/six skipped overall. The native stripping/symlink runner proof remains intact.

## Scope and retained limits

The corrected script, AGENTS and recipe now explicitly limit --prune to macOS and this user's observable processes. This is not a whole-machine other-user cwd guarantee. Candidate naming/detached/head checks remain structural namespace evidence, not a creation receipt.

Removal still uses git worktree remove without --force. All decision/brake reads precede removals; a removal-stage timeout stops later attempts but cannot imply rollback of an operation already started.

The reviewed checkout is clean, detached and equal to the remote CLEAN/ready full SHA. No repository edits, dependencies, vitest runs, live process probes or real removals were performed. Round 2 was held without a published verdict; this grades the final round-3 subject.
